title: fix(client): adopt the Rosette Compare baseline client
intent: Make useRosetteCompareApi.ts the only Axios client for the four Rosette baseline and diff calls, and keep RosetteComparePanel.vue as the unrouted presentation layer. Axios stays installed. No backend, route, archive, or manufacturing-authority change.
behavior_change: The panel now calls useRosetteCompareApi for GET/POST /api/compare/baselines, GET /api/compare/baselines/{id}, and POST /api/compare/diff. Payloads, the rosette lane, job-id and preset trimming, localStorage, and update:job-id stay as they were. A stale list, geometry, or diff response cannot overwrite a newer result, and clearing the selection drops a pending geometry response. The baseline id is encodeURIComponent'd; UUID ids are unchanged. The panel no longer imports Axios.

diff_articulation.what_changed: RosetteComparePanel.vue drops its Axios import and the four inline requests. useRosetteCompareApi.ts performs those requests, encodes the baseline id, and ignores a stale response. The Axios overlay retires the panel import and marks the composable canonical but unrouted. The 20-row inventory is unchanged. Production importers go from 18 to 17. A lineage test pins the ruling and is named in core CI.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The extracted composable was unused, so the panel still owned a second copy of the same four calls. Switching the panel over is the reconciliation PR #481 left open. Generation guards stop a delayed response from painting an older baseline or comparison. Nothing here removes Axios or routes the panel.

non_authority: No CAM, readiness, approval, or manufacturing field is added. The panel stays unrouted. /api/compare/lab is not treated as an equivalent client.
